name: VTK Lookup Table Construction with Opacity
aliases: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application > VTK Lookup Table Construction with Opacity
definition: Builds a vtkLookupTable for slice/probe/intensity actors from a colormap, optionally baking per-value alpha from ParaView-style opacity transfer function control points.
summary: VTK Lookup Table Construction with Opacity bakes opacity transfer functions into a 256-entry lookup table, distinguishing itself by precomputing RGBA values rather than applying transfer functions dynamically at render time.
